blurb: Guests rent clean, stylish, easy-to-drive electric Duffy boats on Lake Minnetonka. Boats are slow by design (6 mph) for a relaxing vibe and have weatherproof windows. Rentals accommodate groups up to 12 people and include coolers and a Bluetooth sound system.
extraNote: Membership voucher has a $7 boat launch fee per use for incidentals · Skipper service available for groups of 6 or less at $50 per hour, must arrange 5 days prior · Rental fees can be applied towards membership purchase · Docked at the Port of Excelsior, 2 Water St.
